sloka: वक्तु कामा इह हि मे इंगितानि अनुपलक्षये ।तान् तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्र राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह ॥३-६४-१६॥
transliteration: vaktu kāmā iha hi me iṁgitāni anupalakṣaye ।tān tu dṛṣṭvā naravyāghra rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca ha ॥3-64-16॥

translations.english: With his vision blurred by tears, Rama, the best among men, looked at them and asked them 'Where is Sita'?
